name: Country Codes
description: Look up ISO 3166-1 country and territory codes.

hints.query: Matches the alpha-2, alpha-3, numeric code or the Chinese and English names; typing filters locally, there is nothing to run.
hints.initial: Pick an initial chip to keep only the countries and territories starting with that letter; the number on the chip is the entry count under the current conditions.
hints.output: The dataset is a bundled offline snapshot of ISO 3166-1; the tool never goes online.

faq.a: The alpha-2 letter code drives country top level domains and region identifiers in most systems; alpha-3 and numeric codes show up in customs, treasury and statistics.

faq.q: Why does searching `JP` return only one row?
faq.a: Matching is substring based, and `JP` only occurs in Japan's codes. Searching `j` returns more rows.

faq.q: Is the data up to date?
faq.a: It is an offline snapshot and the version ships with the result. It can lag behind recent changes, so check the official source when precision matters.
